newsitem.title: USA: Pa. Treasurer says state to divest tobacco shrs.
newsitem.headline: Pa. Treasurer says state to divest tobacco shrs.

text.p: Pennsylvania State Treasurer Barbara Hafer said Thursday she is divesting tobacco stocks from investments under her control and calling on the state's pension and workers' compensation funds to do the same.

Hafer said she has ordered investment managers to sell the $227,000 worth of tobacco stocks held by the Tuition Account Program and will introduce motions to divest another $400 million in tobacco stocks at upcoming meetings of the pension boards and the State Workmen's Insurance Fund.
Yesterday Pennsylvania and Missouri became the 24th and 25th states to sue the tobacco industry to recoup state Medicaid funds spent treating smoking-related illnesses.
"It is hypocrisy, pure and simple, for the state to be holding $400 million worth of tobacco stocks while suing tobacco companies for the harm they do," Hafer said.
